newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products-gas oil off, high sulphur fuel up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products-gas oil off, high sulphur fuel up.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday with gas oil waning on the back of weaker underlying futures while high sulphur fuel oil rose, traders said.

Heating oil barges were unchanged at Nov IPE +50 cents/+$1.0 a tonne for prompt delivery and Nov IPE +1.0/+2.0, but the weaker IPE November gas oil contract, which was trading $2.75 cent off at $224.25 a tonne at 0945 GMT, ate into the outright price.
High sulphur barges were stronger with reports of deals done at $121 and $122.
